Our Programs & Field Initiatives

Comprehensive educational, health, and climate adaptation programs designed for high-risk coastal environments.

SPECIAL PROGRAMS

Integrated Programs for Sustainable Growth

Click any program below to view activity photos, field breakdowns, and impact data.

Child Education

Sundarbans Learning Hubs & Scholarships

Establishing community-managed learning centers and distributing educational kits, uniforms, and books to underprivileged children across Satkhira.

15 Active Hubs
Health & Awareness

Clean Water & Hygiene Literacy

Educating children and mothers on water purification, menstrual hygiene, and disease prevention in salinity-affected coastal zones.

35 Workshops Conducted
Climate Action

Coastal Climate Preparedness & Youth Action

Training local youth volunteers in emergency disaster response, tree planting, and community safety during cyclone seasons.

250 Youth Volunteers
Special Initiative

Emergency Sundarbans Disaster Relief & Food Packs

Providing emergency dry rations, clean water jerrycans, and medical relief packages to marooned coastal families during flash floods.

3,200 Relief Kits Delivered
FIELD METHODOLOGY

Community-Driven & Transparent Execution

Every program at Dinghy Foundation is designed in close consultation with coastal mothers, school teachers, and village elders. We maintain 100% financial auditing, direct volunteer deployment, and verifiable metrics across Satkhira district.

DINGHY FOUNDATION
